preservation: No global data reset, deletion, or remote deployment. Existing session namespaces/resources kept; browser audit prepared independent lab environments.
limitations: Additional policies/bot classification/segments/scans/AI/CI-CD remain existing local models; they are exercised through practice controls and test engine, not real XC services.
All-lab browser screen coverage is not a claim that every lab's entire manual workflow or pixel fidelity was verified. Representative manual workflows are listed separately.
Class9 is community supplement, not official F5 Class9.
